artifacts.summary: Deterministic completeness of TM+ + Determined with the coincidence corollary, non-definability of the stability modal, underivability of both pasting axioms, and the conservativity corollaries -- all sorry-free.

completion_data.completion_summary: Landed the mechanical TM+ metatheory sorry-free at all four frame classes: deterministic completeness of TM+ + Determined together with logicDeterministicEqDeterminedValid (the logic of the deterministic frames and the logic of the Determined-valid frames coincide, and both are axiomatized by TM+ + Determined, without Determined defining either class); stabNotDefinable (no Formula is equivalent to the PlusFormula box-dot Fp); pasteNotNaiveDerivable and untlPasteNotNaiveDerivable via a new coarsened-state semantics with its own naive-soundness theorem; and the conservativity corollaries including detDerivable_ofFormula_iff. General (nondeterministic) TM+ completeness is stated nowhere and sorried nowhere, and is recorded as open in three READMEs and docs/theorem-index.md citing Reynolds 2003 and Zanardo 1991. Full lake build clean (2629 jobs) and every check of scripts/check-module-invariants.sh passes, C2/C3/C14 included.
